build_pipeline_class: build the Pipeline class for an OpenAI manifold pipeline with configurable valves
create_valves_config: create a Valves config class with OPENAI_API_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY settings
fetch_openai_models: fetch available OpenAI models from the API and filter by gpt, o1, o3, o4 substrings
run_chat_completion: run a chat completion request to OpenAI with streaming or non-streaming response
handle_lifecycle_events: handle pipeline lifecycle events including startup, shutdown, and valves update
